hebrewText: אֶפְתְּחָ֣ה בְ/מָשָׁ֣ל פִּ֑/י אַבִּ֥יעָה חִ֝יד֗וֹת מִנִּי קֶֽדֶם

tokens.bdb: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
tokens.kjv: appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave(-n), loose (self), (be, be set) open(-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent.

tokens.bdb: properly, a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature; hence, a simile (as an adage, poem, discourse)
the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
tokens.kjv: accord(-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command(-ment), [idiom] eat, edge, end, entry, [phrase] file, hole, [idiom] in, mind, mouth, part, portion, [idiom] (should) say(-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, [idiom] spoken, talk, tenor, [idiom] to, [phrase] two-edged, wish, word.
tokens.explanation: peh — boca, linguagem, beira, entrada, abertura

tokens.bdb: to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor)
tokens.kjv: belch out, flowing, pour out, send forth, utter (abundantly).

tokens.bdb: a puzzle, hence, a trick, conundrum, sententious maxim
tokens.kjv: dark saying (sentence, speech), hard question, proverb, riddle.

tokens.bdb: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
tokens.kjv: above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, [idiom] neither, [idiom] nor, (out) of, over, since, [idiom] then, through, [idiom] whether, with.

tokens.bdb: the front, of place (absolutely, the fore part, relatively the East) or time (antiquity); often used adverbially (before, anciently, eastward)
tokens.kjv: aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, [idiom] ever(-lasting), forward, old, past. Compare H6926 (קִדְמָה).
